sentences.en: And the real heart of the strike is not about wages, but it's about whether non-union shops can come into any job where there's a carpenter union.
sentences.zh: 罢工的核心不在于工资，而在于非工会商铺是否可以进入任何有木匠工会的工地。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: They think they're going to win on this.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己能赢。

sentences.en: But instead, the strike drags on for four months.
sentences.zh: 但罢工却持续了四个月之久。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they're not working during this period.
sentences.zh: 这段时间他们没法开工。

sentences.en: They're not working during this period.
sentences.zh: 这段时间他们没法开工。

sentences.en: They're losing money.
sentences.zh: 他们在亏钱。

sentences.en: They've basically underestimated how determined the home builders would be.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上低估了房屋建筑商的决心。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, other local unions have gotten involved.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，其他地方工会也卷入了进来。

sentences.en: Because we were fighting other trades at that period and not fighting where we should have been fighting.
sentences.zh: 因为当时我们忙着和其他行业斗，而不是把精力放在该放的地方。

sentences.en: There's a lot of infighting and the coalition starts to break down and they have to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 内部矛盾重重，联盟开始瓦解，他们不得不做出妥协。

sentences.en: And in the end, the unions concede to the home builders and let non-union crews on residential sites where there's a unionized carpenter.
sentences.zh: 最终，工会向房屋建筑商让步，允许非工会员工进入有工会木匠的住宅工地。

sentences.en: Basically, they lose on the marquee issue of the strike itself.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们在罢工的核心诉求上输了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But at the time, it doesn't seem like that big of a deal.
sentences.zh: 但当时看来，这似乎没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because while they were letting non-union workers come into unionized residential projects, the unions still had a lock on the commercialized work in the construction industry.
sentences.zh: 因为虽然他们允许非工会工人进入工会化的住宅项目，但工会仍然牢牢控制着建筑业的商业项目。

sentences.en: We had so much what they called commercial work.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多所谓的商业项目了。

sentences.en: We had so much.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多了。

sentences.en: California is building a lot and they're building a lot of commercial.
sentences.zh: 加州当时建设规模很大，而且有很多商业建筑。

sentences.en: They're building hotels.
sentences.zh: 他们在建酒店。

sentences.en: They're building hospitals.
sentences.zh: 他们在建医院。

sentences.en: They're building strip malls.
sentences.zh: 他们在建商业街。

sentences.en: It was just flowing out of the cracks.
sentences.zh: 项目多得数不过来。

sentences.en: So the unions say, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 所以工会说，没关系。

sentences.en: We'll just go do commercial.
sentences.zh: 我们去做商业项目就行了。

sentences.en: I brought it up more than once.
sentences.zh: 我提过不止一次。

sentences.en: They said, oh, we had too much.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，我们项目太多了。

sentences.en: Don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: There's too much commercial.
sentences.zh: 商业项目多的是。

sentences.en: Go to work.
sentences.zh: 去干活吧。

sentences.en: So if they cede some of their work in the residential sector.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们放弃住宅领域的部分工作。

sentences.en: They'll be OK.
sentences.zh: 他们会没事的。

sentences.en: They'll be OK.
sentences.zh: 他们会没事的。

sentences.en: The commercial will make up for the residential.
sentences.zh: 商业项目会弥补住宅项目的损失。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No big deal.
sentences.zh: 没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Do you think it was a mistake that you didn't worry about residential?
sentences.zh: 你认为当时不担心住宅项目是个错误吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because it eliminated a whole section of our industry.
sentences.zh: 因为它淘汰了我们行业的一整个板块。

sentences.en: I honestly think when we lost residential, it changed my trajectory in the industry.
sentences.zh: 我真心认为，当我们失去住宅市场时，我在行业里的职业轨迹就改变了。

sentences.en: Matt immediately notices a change.
sentences.zh: 马特立刻察觉到了变化。

sentences.en: The first thing he sees is he goes into the union hall where he's supposed to see his jobs.
sentences.zh: 他首先注意到的是，当他去工会大厅找工作时。

sentences.en: And there's far fewer residential jobs available.
sentences.zh: 可供选择的住宅工作少了很多。

sentences.en: There are just less of them.
sentences.zh: 确实变少了。

sentences.en: And the ones that are available are a lot smaller.
sentences.zh: 而且剩下的那些规模也小得多。

sentences.en: There's just like they're not building 60, 80 tracks of homes.
sentences.zh: 他们不再像以前那样一次建60到80栋房子了。

sentences.en: Maybe it's 10.
sentences.zh: 可能只有10栋。

sentences.en: That's when two gates started coming up.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，双门禁制度开始出现了。

sentences.en: We had a union gate and a non-union gate.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个工会门禁和一个非工会门禁。

sentences.en: And when he goes to the job sites, he starts seeing two gates.
sentences.zh: 当他去工地时，他开始看到两个门禁。

sentences.en: One for union crews and one for non-union crews.
sentences.zh: 一个给工会员工，一个给非工会员工。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: And they're keeping those workers separate.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些工人分开了。

sentences.en: So remember, though, at this time in the early 1980s, both the unionized and non-unionized workers were still American-born workers.
sentences.zh: 记住，在20世纪80年代初，工会工人和非工会工人其实都是在美国出生的工人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That's just the demographics of this workforce.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时劳动力的构成。

sentences.en: That's the demographics of America at the time.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时美国的人口结构。

sentences.en: But in the early 1980s was the beginning of Reaganism, and he was very pro-business, but he was also very pro-immigrant.
sentences.zh: 但在80年代初，里根主义开始了，他非常支持商业，但也非常支持移民。

sentences.en: He had a huge amnesty program.
sentences.zh: 他实施了一个大规模的特赦计划。

sentences.en: And his successor, George H.W.
sentences.zh: 而他的继任者乔治·H·W·布什。

sentences.en: Bush, saw an even bigger wave of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 看到了更大规模的移民潮。

sentences.en: And he expanded Reagan's amnesty prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他扩大了里根的特赦计划。

sentences.en: And he ends up signing the Immigration Act of 1990, which is this major piece of legislation that created the TPS program,
sentences.zh: 他最终签署了1990年的《移民法》，这是一项重要的立法，创建了临时保护身份（TPS）项目、

sentences.en: H-1B visas, a visa lottery program.
sentences.zh: H-1B签证和签证抽签项目。

sentences.en: He does, you know, also add in some border protections and try to reduce illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 他确实也增加了一些边境保护措施，试图减少非法移民。

sentences.en: But overall, this is a time where the borders are porous, and it was not the hard border that we think of today.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，那是一个边境开放的时代，不像我们今天认为的那样边境森严。

sentences.en: So all these immigrants are looking for work, and many of them are coming in without documentation.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些移民都在寻找工作，其中许多人没有合法证件。

sentences.en: And many of them also are coming in either already knowing how to build homes, or they come and join family members who've already gotten jobs in construction.
sentences.zh: 他们中许多人要么已经掌握了盖房子的技能，要么来投奔已经在建筑业找到工作的家人。

sentences.en: And so construction becomes a natural place for immigrants to find work.
sentences.zh: 因此，建筑业成了移民寻找工作的自然选择。

sentences.en: And for the American worker, these home construction jobs are becoming less appealing as non-union work grows in the sector.
sentences.zh: 而对于美国工人来说，随着非工会工作在这一领域的增长，这些房屋建筑工作变得越来越没有吸引力。

sentences.en: And these non-union jobs don't have those good benefits.
sentences.zh: 这些非工会工作没有那些优厚的福利。

sentences.en: And so Matt starts seeing the labor force changing.
sentences.zh: 于是马特开始看到劳动力结构的变化。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there's more Spanish being spoken on the job sites.
sentences.zh: 突然间，工地上说西班牙语的人多了起来。

sentences.en: A few years later, the foremen are often Spanish-speaking.
sentences.zh: 几年后，工头往往都是说西班牙语的。

sentences.en: I literally was working one day, and I turned around on the roof, and I happened to be the oldest guy and the whitest guy on the roof.
sentences.zh: 有一次我干活时，转过身在屋顶上看了看，发现自己竟然是屋顶上年纪最大、肤色最白的人。

sentences.en: But I wonder what happened to all the white guys.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想知道那些白人伙计都去哪了。

sentences.en: I really did.
sentences.zh: 我真的想过。

sentences.en: They all went different places.
sentences.zh: 他们都去了别的地方。

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to do it anymore.
sentences.zh: 没人想再干这行了。

sentences.en: So, just to be clear about the sequence of events here, homebuilders decide to challenge the union's hold over the construction of housing.
sentences.zh: 所以，为了理清这里的事件顺序：房屋建筑商决定挑战工会对住宅建设的控制权。

sentences.en: They say, we want non-union workers.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们需要非工会工人。

sentences.en: They fight the unionized workers to get that to happen.
sentences.zh: 他们与工会工人抗争以实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And as that's happening, these waves of immigrants are coming to the U.S., and they are being introduced especially to this non-union world of home construction,
sentences.zh: 而在这一切发生的同时，移民潮涌入美国，他们被引入了非工会化的房屋建筑领域，

sentences.en: which it sounds like is very open to hiring them.
sentences.zh: 听起来这个领域非常乐意雇佣他们。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's almost like a parallel experience is happening.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是发生了一段平行的经历。

sentences.en: Because, you know, while Matt is noticing that the folks who look like him on the job site are disappearing, I spoke with a lot of immigrants who arrived during that time period,
sentences.zh: 因为，当马特注意到工地上像他一样的人正在消失时，我采访了许多在那段时间抵达的移民，

sentences.en: and they tell almost a similar story to what Matt's youth was like.
sentences.zh: 他们讲述的故事和马特年轻时的经历几乎如出一辙。

sentences.en: So, one guy I spoke with was named Mariano Martinez.
sentences.zh: 我采访的一个人叫马里亚诺·马丁内斯。

sentences.en: So, where were you born?
sentences.zh: 你出生在哪里？

sentences.en: Oaxaca, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥瓦哈卡。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And he's also a roofer.
sentences.zh: 他也是个屋顶工人。

sentences.en: And he arrived in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他抵达了美国。

sentences.en: He was 19.
sentences.zh: 当时他19岁。

sentences.en: He came in the late 1980s from Oaxaca, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他在20世纪80年代末从墨西哥瓦哈卡来到这里。

sentences.en: So, you walked across the border?
sentences.zh: 所以，你是步行穿过边境的？

sentences.en: And it was easier then?
sentences.zh: 那时候更容易吗？

sentences.en: Back in the day, yeah.
sentences.zh: 过去是那样，没错。

sentences.en: It was like not even half hour.
sentences.zh: 连半小时都不到。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Did it cost a lot of money or?
sentences.zh: 那需要花很多钱吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: But it was like $110, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是110美元左右。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: He crosses the border with the help of a coyote.
sentences.zh: 他在“蛇头”的帮助下越过了边境。

sentences.en: He's initially working at a gardening center, and he's not making very much money.
sentences.zh: 他最初在一家园艺中心工作，赚的钱并不多。

sentences.en: He got laid off.
sentences.zh: 他被解雇了。

sentences.en: And, like Matt, a friend tells him about roofing.
sentences.zh: 然后，就像马特一样，一个朋友告诉了他屋顶工的工作。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Quite literally, it is a parallel story.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是一个平行的故事。

sentences.en: It is a parallel story.
sentences.zh: 确实是一个平行的故事。

sentences.en: And so, what did your friend say about roofing?
sentences.zh: 那么，你朋友是怎么评价屋顶工这份工作的？

sentences.en: Well, he said it was a hard work, but if you like it, it's a good job.
sentences.zh: 他说工作很辛苦，但如果你喜欢的话，这是一份不错的工作。

sentences.en: So, he doesn't speak any English.
sentences.zh: 所以，他一句英语都不会说。

sentences.en: He shows up on a job site.
sentences.zh: 他出现在工地上。

sentences.en: They put him on a roof.
sentences.zh: 他们让他上屋顶。

sentences.en: He's got to rip off an old roof.
sentences.zh: 他得把旧屋顶拆掉。

sentences.en: It's horrible work.
sentences.zh: 那是份糟糕透顶的工作。

sentences.en: He absolutely hates it.
sentences.zh: 他简直恨透了。

sentences.en: He thinks he's never going to do this again.
sentences.zh: 他想他再也不会干这行了。

sentences.en: But.
sentences.zh: 但是。

sentences.en: I really need the job.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要这份工作。

sentences.en: So, I act like I really know what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我装作很懂行的样子。

sentences.en: But definitely then.
sentences.zh: 但确实在那之后。

sentences.en: The money's a lot better.
sentences.zh: 钱好赚多了。

sentences.en: And he comes back the next day anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，他第二天还是回来了。

sentences.en: And in a few months, he's making $100 a day in cash.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，他每天能赚100美元现金。

sentences.en: So, the money's good, but there's no benefits.
sentences.zh: 所以，钱是不错，但没有任何福利。

sentences.en: And then, did you ever have health insurance?
sentences.zh: 那么，你当时有健康保险吗？

sentences.en: No, not at that time.
sentences.zh: 没有，那时候没有。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: There's no retirement.
sentences.zh: 没有退休金。

sentences.en: There's no paid vacation.
sentences.zh: 没有带薪休假。

sentences.en: But it's more money than he's ever seen.
sentences.zh: 但他赚的钱比他以前见过的都要多。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And his friends actually tell him, you know, there is union work you can get, but it's not worth it because it's not steady.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友其实告诉过他，你知道，有些工会工作可以做，但不值得，因为不稳定。

sentences.en: There's all this work in the non-union work.
sentences.zh: 非工会工作机会到处都是。

sentences.en: There's so much to be had.
sentences.zh: 机会多得是。

sentences.en: The union work, there's all these rules.
sentences.zh: 工会工作有很多规矩。

sentences.en: And you may be out of work sometimes.
sentences.zh: 而且有时候你可能会失业。

sentences.en: So, he never even bothers to consider union work.
sentences.zh: 所以，他从来没考虑过工会工作。

sentences.en: And he doesn't have to.
sentences.zh: 而且他也不需要考虑。

sentences.en: And he doesn't have to.
sentences.zh: 他确实不需要。

sentences.en: Because the contracts no longer require it.
sentences.zh: 因为合同不再要求那样做了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And for Mariano, the money is so good that by the late 90s, he's also married and he has enough money to buy a house, also in Southern California.
sentences.zh: 对马里亚诺来说，收入非常可观，到了90年代末，他不仅结了婚，还有足够的钱在南加州买了一套房子。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm really curious, as immigrants like Mariano are starting to take these non-union home construction jobs, what is happening to people like Matt?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，当像马里亚诺这样的移民开始从事这些非工会的房屋建筑工作时，像马特这样的人会怎样？

sentences.en: Clearly, he's looking around and the world is changing, but I presume that he's still getting plenty of union construction work?
sentences.zh: 显然，他环顾四周，世界正在改变，但我猜他应该还是能接到很多工会建筑工作吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's not even looking at the jobs that Mariano's looking at.
sentences.zh: 他甚至根本没看马里亚诺在看的那些工作。

sentences.en: So, remember, he's still looking at the jobs on the union hall.
sentences.zh: 记住，他还是只盯着工会大厅里的工作。

sentences.en: So, he's not seeing Mariano's jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以，他看不到马里亚诺做的那些工作。

sentences.en: Unionized workers have just shifted increasingly into commercial work.
sentences.zh: 工会工人已经越来越多地转向商业建筑领域了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As they kind of predicted.
sentences.zh: 正如他们预料的那样。

sentences.en: As they predicted.
sentences.zh: 正如他们所预料的。

sentences.en: So, it sounds like, well, what's the difference?
sentences.zh: 听起来，嗯，那有什么区别呢？

sentences.en: I mean, a job is a job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，工作就是工作。

sentences.en: A roof is a roof.
sentences.zh: 屋顶就是屋顶。

sentences.en: Commercial work, did you go up and do high-rises?
sentences.zh: 商业建筑，你以前去盖过高层建筑吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 去过。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: How was that?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Was that hard?
sentences.zh: 很难吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was hard.
sentences.zh: 是的，很难。

sentences.en: Was it harder than residential roofing?
sentences.zh: 比住宅屋顶工程更难吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: But putting a roof on a two-story house in the Orange County suburbs is a lot different than putting a roof on a 30-story tower.
sentences.zh: 但在奥兰治县郊区给两层楼的房子盖屋顶，和给30层的大楼盖屋顶完全是两码事。

sentences.en: These are multi-million dollar projects.
sentences.zh: 这些都是价值数百万美元的项目。

sentences.en: There's a lot of pressure to get them built very faSt.
sentences.zh: 为了赶工期，压力非常大。

sentences.en: You're up on steel beaMs.
sentences.zh: 你得站在钢梁上。

sentences.en: You can get seriously injured.
sentences.zh: 很容易受重伤。

sentences.en: It's very hard, hard work.
sentences.zh: 那是相当艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: The hours are much longer.
sentences.zh: 工时也长得多。

sentences.en: Just like that.
sentences.zh: 就是那样。

sentences.en: Trying to get the trash off.
sentences.zh: 还得清理垃圾。

sentences.en: We'd put these big, giant tubes up, and you would throw the trash in the tube from the roof.
sentences.zh: 我们会架起那种巨大的管子，然后从屋顶把垃圾扔进管子里。

sentences.en: And if it got stuck, well, you had to send the smallest guy down on a rope inside the tube.
sentences.zh: 如果堵住了，好吧，你就得派个最瘦的人系着绳子钻进管子里去。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, Matt tells stories of just intense physical labor and real danger with real injuries.
sentences.zh: 你知道，马特讲过很多关于高强度体力劳动和真正危险、甚至导致严重受伤的故事。

sentences.en: I've broken my back twice.
sentences.zh: 我的背断过两次。

sentences.en: I've ripped off this arm, ripped off this wrist, ripped off this elbow.
sentences.zh: 我的手臂撕裂过，手腕撕裂过，手肘也撕裂过。

sentences.en: He fell off a roof and ripped his arm off his body and had it reattached.
sentences.zh: 他从屋顶摔下来，手臂和身体撕裂了，后来又接了回去。

sentences.en: Showed me the scars.
sentences.zh: 他还给我看了伤疤。

sentences.en: My knee is completely wiped out.
sentences.zh: 我的膝盖彻底废了。

sentences.en: I've broken both my ankles several times, broken my pelvis.
sentences.zh: 我的脚踝断过好几次，骨盆也断过。

sentences.en: Fractured ribs.
sentences.zh: 肋骨骨折。

sentences.en: But even despite how difficult the job was, Matt and other commercial roofers still had enough work and a decent salary and benefits to hang on and to build a good, solid life.
sentences.zh: 但尽管工作如此艰苦，马特和其他商业屋顶工依然有足够的工作量、体面的薪水和福利，让他们能够坚持下去，过上稳定美好的生活。

sentences.en: But then something happens that no one anticipated that makes American-born, unionized workers like Matt feel even more left behind.
sentences.zh: 但后来发生了一件谁也没预料到的事，让像马特这样在美国出生的工会工人感到更加被抛弃了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像你们刚才听到的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: So, Wanda, what happens that makes life and work even worse for folks like Matt?
sentences.zh: 那么，旺达，发生了什么事让像马特这样的人的生活和工作变得更糟了？

sentences.en: The housing boom.
sentences.zh: 房地产繁荣。

sentences.en: Not intuitive, but I know you're going to explain.
sentences.zh: 这不太直观，但我知道你会解释的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you all remember, in the early 2000s, there was this huge housing boom fueled by subprime mortgages.
sentences.zh: 如果大家还记得的话，21世纪初，在次级抵押贷款的推动下，出现了一场巨大的房地产繁荣。

sentences.en: And Americans start building millions of new homes.
sentences.zh: 美国人开始建造数百万套新房。

sentences.en: And also, they're not just building anywhere.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们不仅仅是在任何地方盖房。

sentences.en: They're building in the Sun Belt.
sentences.zh: 他们是在“阳光地带”盖房。

sentences.en: States like Arizona, Nevada, and Texas, and California, where there's a lot of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 像亚利桑那州、内华达州、德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州，那里有很多移民。

sentences.en: Because these are border states.
sentences.zh: 因为这些都是边境州。

sentences.en: And many of these states are right-to-work states.
sentences.zh: 而且这些州大多是“工作权利法”州。

sentences.en: So, they have very, very weak union representation.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们的工会代表权非常非常薄弱。

sentences.en: And so, where the construction industry is growing is increasingly non-union.
sentences.zh: 因此，建筑业增长的地方越来越多地是非工会化的。

sentences.en: And they have this enormous workforce that is moving across the border,
sentences.zh: 他们拥有庞大的劳动力群体，正跨越边境而来，

sentences.en: eager and willing to take these jobs that are not particularly attractive to a worker who's born in the United States.
sentences.zh: 渴望并愿意从事这些对在美国出生的工人来说并不怎么吸引人的工作。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, I'm intuiting from what you're saying that this is boom time for non-union, foreign-born construction workers.
sentences.zh: 所以我从你的话中推断出，这对非工会的外国出生建筑工人来说是一个繁荣时期。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And if you look at the share of foreign-born workers in the construction industry, it is just skyrocketing during this period.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看建筑业中外国出生工人的比例，就会发现这一时期简直是在飙升。

sentences.en: But what's also happening simultaneously is union membership for both foreign-born workers and American-born workers is falling from this peak of 40%.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，外国出生工人和美国出生工人的工会成员比例都在从40%的峰值下降。

sentences.en: It's just falling off a cliff.
sentences.zh: 简直是断崖式下跌。

sentences.en: And while that's happening, wages for both union workers and non-union workers aren't keeping up with everyone else's wages.
sentences.zh: 而在此期间，工会工人和非工会工人的工资都没有跟上其他行业的工资水平。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, because if you think of union workers as, like, the standard of what you're supposed to be paid, then even if you're hiring for a non-union job,
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为如果你把工会工人的工资视为应得工资的标准，那么即使你是在招聘非工会工作，

sentences.en: you're kind of matching that a bit.
sentences.zh: 你也会在一定程度上参考那个标准。

sentences.en: So, as there's fewer workers in unions, there's fewer jobs to be had, wages start to shrink, and then the non-union wages sort of fall in concert.
sentences.zh: 所以，随着工会工人减少，工作机会减少，工资开始缩水，非工会工资也就随之下降了。

sentences.en: Because if the standard starts to go away, then the non-standard pay can start to fall faster.
sentences.zh: 因为如果标准开始消失，那么非标准工资就会下降得更快。

sentences.en: So, in some ways, union work, even if you're not unionized, keeps your standard of living a little bit higher for everyone.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，工会工作即使你不是工会成员，也能让所有人的生活水平保持在较高水平。

sentences.en: And that standard is now falling.
sentences.zh: 而那个标准现在正在下降。

sentences.en: And at the same time, we're seeing this huge wave of immigration that is really transforming the construction industry.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们看到了巨大的移民浪潮，这确实改变了建筑业。

sentences.en: Remember, in 1973, about 5% of construction workers were foreign-born.
sentences.zh: 记住，1973年，大约只有5%的建筑工人是外国出生的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Tiny percent.
sentences.zh: 很小的比例。

sentences.en: Tiny percent.
sentences.zh: 很小的比例。

sentences.en: But so, during the housing boom, the percent continues to just soar.
sentences.zh: 但在房地产繁荣期间，这个比例持续飙升。

sentences.en: And now, in California, they make up half of all construction workers.
sentences.zh: 现在，在加利福尼亚州，他们占了所有建筑工人的一半。

sentences.en: In some parts of the construction industry, like drywall, roofing, they're like 80%, 90% of the workers are now foreign-born.
sentences.zh: 在建筑业的某些领域，比如干墙、屋顶工程，现在有80%、90%的工人是外国出生的。

sentences.en: And also, the unions provided huge apprenticeship prograMs.
sentences.zh: 此外，工会还提供庞大的学徒计划。

sentences.en: Matt came in and was trained on day one.
sentences.zh: 马特入行第一天就接受了培训。

sentences.en: He went through a long apprenticeship program where he got trained to do a union roof.
sentences.zh: 他经历了一个漫长的学徒计划，在那里他接受了工会屋顶工程的培训。

sentences.en: When Mariano came, there was no apprenticeship program.
sentences.zh: 当马里亚诺来的时候，已经没有学徒计划了。

sentences.en: He was just trained by his friends.
sentences.zh: 他只是由朋友带出来的。

sentences.en: So, you don't have that apprenticeship program that was a pipeline to train a new workforce because the unions don't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，你没有了那个作为培训新劳动力的渠道的学徒计划，因为工会已经不存在了。

sentences.en: And so, young people graduating from high school are no longer putting on their hot boots and getting on a roof.
sentences.zh: 因此，从高中毕业的年轻人不再穿上工作靴去屋顶干活了。

sentences.en: So, even before the housing boom inevitably yields to a housing crash that we all remember,
sentences.zh: 所以，甚至在房地产繁荣不可避免地导致我们都记得的那场房地产崩盘之前，

sentences.en: the entire infrastructure that encourages American-born workers to go into construction is eroding on top of the fact that the wage advantages of entering this industry are starting to evaporate as well.
sentences.zh: 鼓励美国出生工人进入建筑业的整个基础设施正在瓦解，更不用说进入这个行业的工资优势也开始消失了。

sentences.en: Right, and all these things are happening together.
sentences.zh: 没错，所有这些事情都在同时发生。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: the pathways to get into construction for an American-born worker are rapidly disappearing because the unions are disappearing because the construction that's happening is happening in places where there's no unions and they're building residential homes.
sentences.zh: 美国出生工人进入建筑业的途径正在迅速消失，因为工会正在消失，因为现在的建筑工程都发生在没有工会的地方，而且他们盖的是住宅。

sentences.en: And instead, what's happening is a pathway for immigrants.
sentences.zh: 相反，出现的是一条移民的途径。

sentences.en: So, Mariano arrives.
sentences.zh: 于是，马里亚诺来了。

sentences.en: His friend tells him about this job.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友告诉他这份工作。

sentences.en: He brings cousins and got them jobs in construction in Southern California as immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他把表亲们也带过来，让他们作为移民在南加州从事建筑工作。

sentences.en: And that becomes the new pathway into construction.
sentences.zh: 这成了进入建筑业的新途径。

sentences.en: So, what happens when this housing boom inevitably becomes a housing bust in 2007, 2008, 2009?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这场房地产繁荣在2007、2008、2009年不可避免地变成房地产萧条时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: It's a complete disaster for the construction industry.
sentences.zh: 这对建筑业来说是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: No industry faced more job losses than construction.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个行业面临的失业人数比建筑业更多。

sentences.en: Almost two million workers lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 近两百万工人失去了工作。

sentences.en: That's one in four construction workers lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 也就是每四个建筑工人中就有一个失业。

sentences.en: For workers like Matt, they were staring down the barrel of a very bleak future.
sentences.zh: 对于像马特这样的工人来说，他们面对的是一个非常黯淡的未来。

sentences.en: It had already become a pretty hostile environment for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说已经是一个相当恶劣的环境了。

sentences.en: So, Matt is 51 and he walks away.
sentences.zh: 所以，51岁的马特选择了离开。

sentences.en: He quits the construction industry in the middle of the housing crisis.
sentences.zh: 他在房地产危机期间退出了建筑业。

sentences.en: He retires.
sentences.zh: 他退休了。

sentences.en: He gets his pension and he walks away.
sentences.zh: 他拿到了养老金，然后离开了。

sentences.en: And he is one of millions of workers who did the same thing.
sentences.zh: 他是数百万做同样选择的工人之一。

sentences.en: And so, as the industry starts to churn again and starts to rebuild, it never reaches the levels it did in 2000s, which is what is sort of setting us up for where we are today.
sentences.zh: 因此，当行业开始重新运转并开始重建时，它再也没有达到2000年代的水平，这在某种程度上导致了我们今天的处境。

sentences.en: Homebuilders are not building at scale.
sentences.zh: 房屋建筑商不再大规模建设。

sentences.en: They're not building the number of houses Americans need.
sentences.zh: 他们建造的房屋数量无法满足美国人的需求。

sentences.en: And there's a labor force that was just never recovered.
sentences.zh: 而且劳动力也从未恢复。

sentences.en: We're short 300,000 workers because they left and they retired and they didn't come back.
sentences.zh: 我们短缺了30万名工人，因为他们离开了，退休了，而且没有回来。

sentences.en: And we don't have the pipeline of new, young, American-born workers to fill those jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们也没有新的、年轻的、美国出生的工人来填补这些职位。

sentences.en: So, now we have a workforce that is incredibly dependent on the immigrant workers who have been here and have been working and building homes for years in this country.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我们的劳动力非常依赖那些多年来一直在这个国家工作和建造房屋的移民工人。

sentences.en: And they're being deported.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正在被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: They're being deported from job sites and they're being deported from Home Depots.
sentences.zh: 他们正从工作现场被驱逐，也正从家得宝（Home Depot）被驱逐。

sentences.en: And they're being deported from their homes.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至正从自己的家中被驱逐。

sentences.en: And if they aren't being deported, they're afraid to come to work.
sentences.zh: 即便没有被驱逐，他们也因为害怕而不敢去上班。

sentences.en: It can't have escaped the awareness of the president and those around him that at this moment when America desperately needs a lot more housing and faces a shortage of workers to build it,
sentences.zh: 总统及其身边的人不可能没有意识到，在此时此刻，美国迫切需要更多的住房，却面临着建筑工人短缺的问题，

sentences.en: that this deportation campaign is at odds with the goal of getting more housing and more affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 而这场驱逐行动与增加住房供应、提供更多经济适用房的目标是背道而驰的。

sentences.en: And I wonder if the Trump administration assumed, believed, that if it was deporting all these foreign-born workers who are building these houses,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇特朗普政府是否曾假设或相信，如果把这些建造房屋的外国出生工人全部驱逐出境，

sentences.en: that it might bring the American-born workforce back somehow?
sentences.zh: 就能以某种方式让美国本土劳动力回归？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that is the vision, is that wages will rise because now you'll have to pay them again the good wages that you once had.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这就是他们的愿景，即工资会因此上涨，因为你现在必须再次支付他们曾经拥有的优厚工资。

sentences.en: I think that's J.D.
sentences.zh: 我认为这肯定是万斯（J.D. Vance）的论点。

sentences.en: Vance's argument for sure.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Home builders will have to pay more and American workers will come and take these jobs.
sentences.zh: 房屋建筑商将不得不支付更多薪水，而美国工人会回来从事这些工作。

sentences.en: And that the problem is, again, that immigrants have taken their jobs.
sentences.zh: 问题再次回到了移民抢走了他们的工作这一点上。

sentences.en: And if you remove the immigrants from the equation, the Americans will fill the void.
sentences.zh: 如果把移民从这个等式中剔除，美国人就会填补这个空缺。

sentences.en: Is there any evidence that that's starting to happen?
sentences.zh: 有任何证据表明这种情况正在发生吗？

sentences.en: There's actually evidence that it's not.
sentences.zh: 事实上，证据表明情况并非如此。

sentences.en: So researchers found that in communities where there was a high level of deportation, employment dropped for immigrant workers.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，在驱逐程度较高的社区，移民工人的就业率确实下降了。

sentences.en: But here's what's kind of surprising.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是：

sentences.en: Employment also fell for American-born workers.
sentences.zh: 美国本土工人的就业率也下降了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: And what does the study say is the causality there?
sentences.zh: 那么研究认为其中的因果关系是什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, you would think that contractors would raise wages because they're short on workers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可能会认为承包商会因为缺人而提高工资。

sentences.en: But that's not really the way the industry works.
sentences.zh: 但这个行业并非如此运作。

sentences.en: American-born workers and foreign-born workers aren't evenly split across the industry.
sentences.zh: 美国本土工人和外国出生工人在行业内的分布并不均匀。

sentences.en: You have a concentration of foreign-born workers who maybe build the foundations.
sentences.zh: 你拥有一批外国出生工人，他们可能负责建造地基。

sentences.en: So let's say your crew that builds a foundation doesn't show up because they've all been deported or they're afraid to go to work.
sentences.zh: 假设你负责打地基的团队没来，因为他们都被驱逐了，或者不敢去上班。

sentences.en: So you don't build a foundation.
sentences.zh: 那么你就没法打地基。

sentences.en: So then when you call in the carpenter—
sentences.zh: 所以当你叫来木匠时——

sentences.en: They're like, what am I supposed to build on?
sentences.zh: 他们会问，我该在什么上面施工呢？

sentences.en: There's no foundation.
sentences.zh: 根本没有地基。

sentences.en: So you don't need the carpenter.
sentences.zh: 所以你就不需要木匠了。

sentences.en: So you just don't hire him.
sentences.zh: 所以你干脆就不雇佣他了。

sentences.en: You know, in my reporting,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我的报道中，

sentences.en: I spoke with a number of contractors who said jobs that were taking three months to build now take five months to build because there's just fewer workers to get each stage of the project done.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一些承包商，他们说以前三个月就能完成的工作，现在需要五个月，因为每个阶段能干活的工人变少了。

sentences.en: And they're not paying their workers any more money.
sentences.zh: 而且他们并没有给工人涨工资。

sentences.en: They're just taking longer to get the job done.
sentences.zh: 他们只是花了更长的时间来完成工作。

sentences.en: And this housing bill doesn't address the labor force.
sentences.zh: 而这项住房法案并没有解决劳动力问题。

sentences.en: It doesn't provide a pathway to a trade school or any requirements to hire unionized labor.
sentences.zh: 它没有提供通往技校的途径，也没有要求雇佣工会劳动力。

sentences.en: So it provides no avenues to expand an American-born workforce.
sentences.zh: 因此，它没有提供任何扩大美国本土劳动力的途径。

sentences.en: There is one place in the bill that does speak to a potential future, and that is the factory-built housing.
sentences.zh: 法案中确实有一个地方提到了潜在的未来，那就是工厂预制住房。

sentences.en: So the bill makes the first major changes to manufactured housing, which means that now we can build lots of different types of factory-built housing.
sentences.zh: 该法案对预制住房进行了首次重大改革，这意味着我们现在可以建造许多不同类型的工厂预制住房。

sentences.en: That kind of housing requires less labor.
sentences.zh: 那种住房所需的劳动力较少。

sentences.en: You don't need as many workers.
sentences.zh: 你不需要那么多工人。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if that's an upside, but—
sentences.zh: 我不确定这算不算是一个利好，但是——

sentences.en: It's an upside for housing, but not for construction workers.
sentences.zh: 这对住房市场是利好，但对建筑工人来说不是。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Rhonda, I want to end by returning to where we began this conversation, which is with these prevailing narratives around why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，朗达（Rhonda），我想以回到我们对话的起点来结束，即围绕美国为何如此依赖外国出生工人的普遍叙事。
